items.summary: Add a personalized dashboard section that is visible only to authenticated users (logged in via Internet Identity). The dashboard should display a welcome message with the user's principal ID and provide placeholders or tracked data for user activity (e.g., last login, pages visited) and saved preferences.

Update the backend Motoko actor to store and retrieve per-user data: visit count (incremented on each authenticated session), last login timestamp, and at least one user-configurable preference (e.g., a display name or preferred contact topic). Expose query and update functions for the frontend to call.

Add a React Query hook in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts to fetch the authenticated user's dashboard data from the backend, and a mutation hook to update preferences. Integrate these hooks into the dashboard UI component.
